revision_kind: Regenerated spring-centred replacement; not recovery of the lost original bytes
author: Christian Ströbele (CrispStrobe)

adaptations: Original new layout and inline r40/L160 cranks; two identical mechanisms retain the corrected Quickstroke physical guide and mount patterns.
Motor support side beams use the upper stator holes and four 7L posts per motor; upper guide shafts and fixed end supports move +40 LDU in X for motor clearance.
One real pin owns each shared triple-thickness joint; no duplicated coincident pins remain.
The uncentred carrier drifted on the small native ground tilt. This regenerated edition adds two real transverse 33 mm centring bands and shifts the ground cross-members 40 LDU toward the hub.
B rear motor crossbar and its two pins move from world Z0 to Z20, preserving ordinary beam-hole alignment while clearing the moving band-anchor top retainer.
All three band anchors are retained 9L axles with close loop flanges. Their tips end at Y420 to clear fixed base rails through full carrier travel.

question: How does the relative phase of two identical reciprocating mechanisms change reaction motion of their passively spring-centred common carrier?

units.orientation: Row-major proper rotation matrices; LDraw +Y points down

mechanism.port_contract: Explicit !BW PORT A/B; both motor origins use the same rotation and encoder sign. Program phase is B encoder minus A encoder.

carrier.antiroll: Two separated double smooth-bore toggle joints; the lower guide pair restrains carrier roll, pitch and yaw while permitting X translation
carrier.centring: Two opposed real 33 mm rubber bands pull transversely toward the saved centre; no added motor, frozen carrier, synthetic slider friction or hidden restoring constraint.

physical_stacks.motor_mounting: Upper stator-hole row y70, two 11L side beams, four 7L posts, perpendicular feet and thin pads into the carrier rails
physical_stacks.hub_mounting: Four shared 3L friction pins seat the hub, carrier rail and crossing beam as one three-member stack
physical_stacks.cold_support: Fixed base bottom plane Y450; outer crosses at Z-340/+340 and central longitudinal lap beams reach the same plane. The former lower middle crossbar is absent.

expected_rigid_bodies: fixed base and its lower guide axles
passive carrier, hub, both motor stators and upper guide axles
A motor rotor, crank and keyed crank pin
A piston carriage and its keyed pivot
B motor rotor, crank and keyed crank pin
B piston carriage and its keyed pivot

observation.phase0: The first-harmonic piston translations add, making the carrier reaction visible
observation.phase180: The first-harmonic piston translations cancel; finite rod length leaves an even-harmonic residual
observation.qualification: Measure actual piston positions relative to the actual carrier and actual carrier translation relative to the actual fixed base; do not substitute the analytical pose as an animation
observation.carrier_amplitude_caveat: Measured finite-trial carrier ranges include spring transients and initial conditions. First-harmonic cancellation at 180 degrees does not imply zero platform motion.

band_centring.physical_routing_note: Fit the two loops side by side in the 10 LDU shaft slot. At the specified planes their 4 LDU sections have 1 LDU separation and 0.5 LDU clearance to the adjacent half-bush faces. The fixed anchors have matching slots.
band_centring.native_model_limit: Native BELT locates a circle at each anchor connector centre and averages both planes at Y330; it does not resolve rubber-to-rubber contact or real rubber calibration.
band_centring.moving_support: 11L bridge at (80,260,0), pinned at Z-100/+100 into the existing hub crossings; keyed 3L beam at Y280, pinned at Z-20/+20.
band_centring.fixed_support: 11L crossbars at (80,400,±120), keyed 3L beams at Y380, and single 3L stack pins at X0/160,Y420 through the support and two base rail layers.

qualification_limits: This contract describes the regenerated model; validation evidence must match model_sha256.
Native program runs and part-metadata/collider sweeps are distinct checks. Neither substitutes for a physical hardware build.
Standard LDraw viewers that ignore !BW BELT will omit the two bands. Standard part meshes remain external library dependencies under their own licenses.
